title: World Blue: Traveling Abroad with Your Business Account
summary: This document explains how to use a World Blue business account abroad: withdraw local currency at foreign ATMs with a 0% foreign ATM fee (minimum $0.00) and up to $100/month in ATM surcharge rebates, send/receive cross-border payments in $140 regions via SEPA (where eligible) or SWIFT, and deposit checks via mobile check deposit up to $20,000/day. It also covers abroad procedures (dynamic currency conversion guidance, receipt retention) and team controls (a “Travel” role, per-user spend limits, approval requirements, and beneficiary-add restrictions).
faqs: How much is the foreign ATM fee for World Blue withdrawals abroad, and is there a rebate on ATM operator surcharges?
Which countries/regions can I send and receive cross-border payments to while traveling, and do I use SEPA or SWIFT?
What steps should I follow to send an international payment while on the road (beneficiary, network, funding currency, submission/status)?
How do I receive cross-border payments from overseas payers while abroad (what receiving details to share, SEPA vs SWIFT)?
What are the limits and best practices for mobile check deposit while traveling internationally?
How can I manage team permissions and approvals for international wires/ATM/carding while employees are abroad?
